```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Example narwhals DataFrame
native_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [0.5, 0.8, 0.3]
})
df = nw.from_native(native_df, eager_only=True)

# Convert columns using narwhals dtypes
converted = df.with_columns(
    user_id=nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    score=nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
)

print(converted.to_native())
```
